description: This file contains core backend logic functions for a role-based learning management system, managing lessons, assignments, and progress. It includes role verification, CRUD operations, and access control mechanisms.

methods.name: require_role(role_header: Optional[str], allowed: List[str])
methods.description: Checks if the provided role_header is within allowed roles; raises HTTP 403 if not authorized.

methods.name: bool is_role(role_header: Optional[str], role: str)
methods.description: Returns True if the role_header matches the specified role (case-insensitive).

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_lessons(role: Optional[str])
methods.description: Retrieves a list of lessons, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_lesson(role: Optional[str], payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new lesson entry; only accessible by Admin.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] update_lesson(role: Optional[str], lesson_id: str, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing lesson identified by lesson_id; only accessible by Admin.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] delete_lesson(role: Optional[str], lesson_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a lesson based on lesson_id; only accessible by Admin.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] attach_storage_path(role: Optional[str], lesson_id: str, storage_path: str)
methods.description: Updates the storage_path for a specific lesson; only accessible by Admin.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_assignments(role: Optional[str], role_filter: Optional[str])
methods.description: Retrieves a list of assignments, optionally filtered by role.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_assignment(role: Optional[str], payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new assignment; accessible by HR and Admin.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_progress(role: Optional[str], assignee: Optional[str])
methods.description: Lists progress entries, with role-based access restrictions.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] upsert_progress(role: Optional[str], payload: Dict[str, Any], header_assignee: Optional[str])
methods.description: Creates or updates a progress record, enforcing role-based permissions.

ctags.name: attach_storage_path
ctags.pattern: /^def attach_storage_path(role: Optional[str], lesson_id: str, storage_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any/

ctags.name: create_assignment
ctags.pattern: /^def create_assignment(role: Optional[str], payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: create_lesson
ctags.pattern: /^def create_lesson(role: Optional[str], payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: delete_lesson
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_lesson(role: Optional[str], lesson_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: list_assignments
ctags.pattern: /^def list_assignments(role: Optional[str], role_filter: Optional[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: list_progress
ctags.pattern: /^def list_progress(role: Optional[str], assignee: Optional[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: update_lesson
ctags.pattern: /^def update_lesson(role: Optional[str], lesson_id: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any/
ctags.signature: (role: Optional[str], lesson_id: str, payload: Dict[str, Any])

ctags.name: upsert_progress
ctags.pattern: /^def upsert_progress(role: Optional[str], payload: Dict[str, Any], header_assignee: Optional[str]/
ctags.signature: (role: Optional[str], payload: Dict[str, Any], header_assignee: Optional[str])
